response.text: Balanced and no period issues so far. Now for duplicates, closed periods by header period, and payments.

arguments.sql: select v."VEND_CD", regexp_replace(upper(i."INV_NO"),'[^A-Z0-9]','','g') k, count(*), array_agg(i."INV_ID"), array_agg(i."INV_NO"), array_agg(i."INV_AMT") from "APINVH" i join "APVEND" v on trim(v."VEND_CD")=trim(i."VEND_CD") group by 1,2 having count(*)>1

select i."INV_ID", i."INV_NO", i."VEND_CD", i."INV_DT", i."INV_AMT", i."JRNL_NO" from "APINVH" i where exists (select 1 from "APINVH" j where j."INV_ID"<>i."INV_ID" and trim(j."VEND_CD")=trim(i."VEND_CD") and j."INV_AMT"=i."INV_AMT" and j."INV_DT"=i."INV_DT") order by 3,4,5

select i."INV_ID", i."INV_NO", i."INV_AMT", i."STAT_CD", coalesce(sum(p."PAY_AMT"),0) paid, count(p."PAY_ID") np from "APINVH" i left join "APPAYM" p on p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID" group by 1,2,3,4 having (i."STAT_CD"='P' and coalesce(sum(p."PAY_AMT"),0)<>i."INV_AMT") or (i."STAT_CD"<>'P' and count(p."PAY_ID")>0) or count(p."PAY_ID")>1

select p."PAY_ID", p."INV_ID", p."PAY_DT", p."PAY_AMT", i."INV_DT", h."JRNL_NO", h."POST_DT", (select sum("DR_AMT") from "GLJRNL" l where l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO" and trim(l."ACCT_CD")='2000') dr2000, (select sum("CR_AMT") from "GLJRNL" l where l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO" and trim(l."ACCT_CD")='1000') cr1000 from "APPAYM" p join "APINVH" i on i."INV_ID"=p."INV_ID" left join "GLJRNH" h on h."SRC_REF"='PAY-'||p."PAY_ID" where h."JRNL_NO" is null or p."PAY_DT"<i."INV_DT" or p."PAY_AMT"<>coalesce((select sum("DR_AMT") from "GLJRNL" l where l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO" and trim(l."ACCT_CD")='2000'),-1) or p."PAY_AMT"<>coalesce((select sum("CR_AMT") from "GLJRNL" l where l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO" and trim(l."ACCT_CD")='1000'),-1)
